_what: What the person's devices report about themselves (src/device-facts.mjs): each device profile reports a few short facts, such as which cameras it sees or whether a switch on it is on. Reports are owned by a named source, so replacing one source's facts keeps the other sources on that profile and removes that source's old facts. A row on the person's Waiting on you list whose "Done once" rule (src/lists.json kind checked-by) passes on one device's merged facts is marked Done by itself. `fact` is the person fact they are kept in; at most `most_devices` identities, `most_sources` source snapshots per identity and `most_facts` merged facts per identity; a fact's name matches `name_pattern` and its value is text of at most `value_chars` characters. `device_chars` caps the display name.

words.bad_device: Name the device these facts are about, in at most {chars} characters.
words.bad_facts: Facts are { name: text } with at most {most} names, each a short name of lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes.
words.bad_sources: A device keeps at most {most} separate sources of facts.
